images.caption: On the 96th anniversary of the 19th Amendment to the Constitution, when women won the right to vote, Congresswomen Nancy Pelosi, Anna Eshoo, Barbara Lee, and Jackie Speier joined Bay Area community leaders at UCSF to reflect on the strides our nation has made towards women’s equality and rededicate ourselves to the important work left to be done. The right to vote guards all other rights – the right to choose, the right to life-saving research and the right to contraception and health care.

images.filename: Congresswoman Pelosi Celebrates 30th Anniversary of UCSF Center for AIDS Prevention Studies (31298758975).jpg
images.caption: Congresswoman Pelosi joins the researchers and staff of the USCF Center for AIDS Prevention Studies (CAPS) as they celebrate 30 years of cutting-edge research dedicated to social, behavioral, and policy science approaches to preventing HIV and AIDS. Pelosi stood with Dr. Steve Morin, a former CAPS Director, who had served as her AIDS policy advisor when she was first elected to Congress.
images.alt: Congresswoman Pelosi joins the researchers and staff of the USCF Center for AIDS Prevention Studies (CAPS) as they celebrate 30 years of cutting-edge research dedicated to social, behavioral, and policy science approaches to preventing HIV and AIDS. Pelosi stood with Dr. Steve Morin, a former CAPS Director, who had served as her AIDS policy advisor when she was first elected to Congress.
